entity.name: Prit Ahir
entity.description: Individual developer based in India, requesting maintenance funding for FormSathi, an existing MIT-licensed prototype developed with substantial AI assistance. It makes no claim of paying users, revenue, verified adoption or fully on-device AI.

projects.name: FormSathi
projects.description: A local-first form-filling prototype with a guided English interview, field checklist, answer sheet and encrypted device-local Answer Vault. The existing repository includes a working local/manual path and automated tests. Optional Firebase/Gemini services are proprietary dependencies; personal content does not fall back to cloud inference. Real Gemini Nano execution remains unverified. The request supports existing software maintenance, security, accessibility and reproducible self-hosting, not an unbuilt idea.

channels.description: Grant payout method to be agreed privately after selection. No payment credentials are published in this draft.

plans.name: 12-week maintenance and accessibility pilot
plans.description: Requested total INR 150000 for 12 weeks, beginning after agreement. Budget: maintainer work 240 hours at INR 500/hour = INR 120000; independent security review allowance INR 15000; accessibility and device-testing/data allowance INR 9000; hosting, domain and backup allowance INR 6000. These are planning allowances, not vendor quotes. Weeks 1-4: triage dependency advisories, update vulnerable packages, verify privacy boundaries, publish a threat model, dependency/license inventory and reproducible setup. Weeks 5-8: improve offline/manual workflows, keyboard and screen-reader access, vault backup/recovery guidance, and add regression tests. Weeks 9-12: seek five consenting adult testers using fictional forms, record attempts and failures without inventing recruitment or success, fix critical usability issues, tag a documented release and publish one community update/demo. Acceptance evidence: clean install, typecheck, build and regression results; every remaining high/critical advisory documented with exposure and mitigation; no personal-content cloud fallback; documented accessibility checks; a candid pilot report even if recruitment fails. Longer-term sustainability: keep the local/manual core free under MIT and assess donations or optional setup support only after genuine demand. No promised customers or future revenue. No overlap with any other grant: if Bagel or another fund supports the same costs, disclose it and reduce or reallocate this request only with funder agreement. Personal milestone: contribute approximately 20 hours/week and publish at least one community engagement during the quarter.
